architecture_decision.architecture: Kotlin/Compose + Chaquopy 17.0.0 + existing EOS on one serialized worker
architecture_decision.correction: Recalculate source after SQLAlchemy relationship refresh in projection and command add/remove paths; two forced-collection regression tests cover four add/remove operations per link kind.
reasoning: Independent A01/A04/A05 calculations, all-recipient invalidation and cleanup pass natively offline after the minimal source-refresh correction.
Measured median edit/calculate/serialize/parse operations are 10–61 ms for the bounded one-fit and two-recipient cases; this supports keeping the serialized boundary.

First-install process-to-ready-draw is 2.960 s; four subsequent cold-process launches range 1.984–2.347 s, median 2.008 s. This is a baseline to improve/validate on physical phones, not a startup usability sign-off.
Normal-startup PSS is 154.1–184.8 MiB; instrumented cumulative snapshots remain below 232 MiB with nine retained fits. These snapshots do not establish peak/long-session memory or per-fit cost.
The 70,395,255-byte dual-ABI debug APK packages the complete offline database and native dependencies; no blocker here justifies replacing EOS or requiring an online backend.
required_later_gates: Physical ARM64 and supported Android API execution; older minimum API remains unverified.
Release-build startup/edit/memory and large/long-lived fit graphs, graphs and UI interaction latency.
Fit lifecycle/release, persistent storage, actual upgrades and stable signing, then user usability confirmation.
architecture_decision.scope: Proceed to B01; not release readiness or full Pyfa parity
